item.title: Senior Greek Military Officer Detained for Allegedly Passing NATO Intelligence to China
item.description: Sources familiar with the case identify the suspect as a 50-year-old wing commander stationed in the coastal area of Kavouri, near Athens. item.title: Critical Raw Materials: EU Audit Underscores Need for Faster Domestic Production
item.description: The EU remains heavily dependent on imports, particularly for materials essential to technologies such as batteries, wind turbines and solar panels. item.title: Η ΚΝΕ, «αιμοδότης» του ΚΚΕ με τη «βούλα» της στατιστικής
item.description: Πέντε πρώην γραμματείς της ΚΝΕ στο Πολιτικό Γραφείο του ΚΚΕ.
